name: 笑傲江湖4公开版
english_name: Xiao Ao Jiang Hu IV — Public Edition (Sunset Reappears)
english_description: Branded in-game as "Sunset Reappears: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer IV," this is the fourth-generation version author Afei built atop the "Yanlong" engine core. It required no fixes to run cleanly under WASM. It shares byte-identical scenes with this collection's jhfy3 and xyzx, both also carrying the "Sunset Reappears" brand, making it a genuine member of that lineage — unlike another group of archives that use the same brand name but actually descend from the unrelated "Tianya" codebase.
